name: Karri Saarinen
bio: Karri Saarinen is co-founder and CEO of Linear. He was Principal Designer and design-systems lead at Airbnb, created founding design at Coinbase, and co-founded YC-backed Kippt and Rails Girls. Public interviews emphasize craft and focus in product building. From Finland; lives in California.
highlights: Co-founder/CEO of Linear; craft-first product ethos.
Prior Airbnb design systems and Coinbase founding design.
Public site lists Linear, Kippt, and Rails Girls history.
